97:| F4 | Three temporal types, never mixed silently. **Calendar dates** (`2026-02-24`, `2026-02`, `2026`) read the same in every viewer time zone. **Instants** (epoch milliseconds declared `type: 'time'`, `Date` objects, ISO strings with an offset) are shown in `timeZone` (default: the viewer's), with the zone named in the tooltip heading and the description. **Wall-clock times** (date-time strings without an offset) are shown as written, with hint AX112. Instants that all fall on the same time of day, whole days apart, raise hint AX111 ("these look like calendar dates"). A bare number is never assumed to be an instant. | Four fixture variants in UTC, America/Los_Angeles and Asia/Kolkata: (a) date strings: identical text in all three; (b) ISO strings with `Z`, (c) epoch ms with `type: 'time'`, (d) `Date` objects: each zone's correct local text, zone visible, AX111 raised; with `timeZone: 'UTC'` or `type: 'date'`: identical. Plus: both DST transitions, a leap day, an unparseable date | R3 |
99:| F6 | Numbers and dates are formatted for the page locale. Ticks and readouts are formatted separately: ticks may be compact (`50K`); tooltip, table and announcements show the full integer part and up to six significant fraction digits, with the unit. A custom formatter that throws falls back to the default and raises a diagnostic. | Expected strings for chosen values (large integers, small decimals, percentages, zoned times) in `en-US`, `de-DE` and `en-IN` | R4 |
100:| F7 | Domains follow one order of precedence: the zoomed view is inside the author's `domain` if given, otherwise inside the automatic domain. The automatic domain contains all data, reference lines and stack totals, and ends at the first tick at or beyond each extreme. A field declared `scale: 'percent'` (0–100) or `'ratio'` (0–1) ends at full scale only when its maximum is at least half of full scale and not above it. Nothing is inferred from a label. | Property tests; `bars` ends at 100 when declared `percent`; a 4% maximum ends at the first tick at or above 4% | R1 |
